bodies.tab:appendix:rules:
R3 enriched & The arm must be able to handle the object, on every leg:
      \texttt{grasp\_m} at most the arm's \texttt{max\_grasp\_m},
      \texttt{mass\_kg} at most the arm's \texttt{payload\_kg}, a
      \texttt{delicate} object needs an arm whose \texttt{delicate\_ok} is
      true. \\
    \addlinespace
    R4 enriched & The arm must appear in the \texttt{reach\_ok\_arms} list of
      the OBJECT. Every object, basket and pad carries one, and it is
      authoritative for reach: use it, do not work reach out from
      coordinates. It says nothing about R3: an arm can often reach an object
      it cannot pick up. Reaching the destination is not required of you; see
      R5. \\
    \addlinespace
    R3 eligible & The arm must appear in the task's \texttt{eligible\_arms}
      list. That list is authoritative and final: it already applies grasp
      size, payload, the delicate rule, reach to the object, and the
      existence of a delivery route. Do not re-derive it from the numbers. An
      EMPTY list means no arm can start this task now, so wait. \\
    \addlinespace
    R4 eligible & \texttt{eligible\_arms} already settles reach. For a basket
      you choose under R7, use the \texttt{reach\_ok\_arms} list on that
      basket. \\
bodies.tab:system:constraints:
Reach    & The arm can reach both the object's current position and the
               task's destination zone. \\
    Grasp    & The object's grasp width in its current pose does not exceed the
               arm's gripper aperture. \\
    Delicacy & An object flagged delicate is assigned only to an arm cleared
               for delicate handling. \\
    Payload  & The object's mass does not exceed the arm's payload limit. \\
    Route    & The path the task requires is available to that arm, accounting
               for zone occupancy. \\
